description: Parent questions for the SchoolPath AI chat. Every case is also checked for: no COP figures (when COP_SOURCE_PERMITTED=false), no admission promises, no good/bad school rankings. `mustMatch` = regexes the answer must contain (case-insensitive); `mustCiteSchool` = answer must cite at least one [[school-code]]; `mustCiteFaq` = must cite an [[faq:id]]; `mustUseTool` = tool the model must call.
